entries.text: You see Richie.

entries.text: You're not supposed to do that. I'm gonna have to stop you!

entries.text: You're not supposed to be here. Do you realize I'm supposed to kill you?
entries.source_text: You're not supposed to be here. Do you realize I'm supposed to kill you?

entries.text: Your shift is over. I'm your replacement.

entries.text: Hub vault inspector. I'm here to inspect the vault. Move aside.
entries.source_text: Hub vault inspector. I'm here to inspect the vault. Move aside.

entries.text: Kid, fight it. End the cycle of violence now!
entries.source_text: Kid, fight it. End the cycle of violence now!

entries.text: Who told you that! Mister, if you attack me, it'll be the biggest mistake of your life!
entries.source_text: Who told you that! Mister, if you attack me, it'll be the biggest mistake of your life!

entries.text: Hi kid! What's in the steel vault?
entries.source_text: Hi kid! What's in the steel vault?

entries.text: Too late, punk. You're dead.
entries.source_text: Too late, punk. You're dead.

entries.text: Uh yeah runk

entries.text: I'm not supposed to be talking to you! Scram!
entries.source_text: I'm not supposed to be talking to you! Scram!

entries.text: It's about time! It's hot in here! Boring too! If I didn't need this job to feed my family, I'd tell Lorenzo to stick it. See you tomorrow.
entries.source_text:
It's about time! It's hot in here! Boring too! If I didn't need this job to feed my family, I'd tell

entries.text: I'm not supposed to leave this place and you're not supposed to be here. Get out!
entries.source_text: I'm not supposed to leave this place and you're not supposed to be here. Get out!

entries.text: You Hub officials make me sick! Inspecting my bosses' vault! What's next, higher taxes? Can't a man earn an honest living anymore without you bureaucrats trying to control everything? One of these days we're going to take a stand. Yeah, one of these days the common man is going to give you fatcats a knee to the balls like you deserve. One of these days we'll get you real good I can't wait By the way, it's not meant personal. I know you're just doing your job. I'll get out of your face while you do your inspection. Bye.

entries.text: Don't give me this crap! Get outta here now or I'll have to shoot you!
entries.source_text: Don't give me this crap! Get outta here now or I'll have to shoot you!

entries.text: Oh yeah. Well no one pushes around Richie Glowsteader and gets away with it!
entries.source_text: Oh yeah. Well no one pushes around Richie Glowsteader and gets away with it!

entries.text: Oh just about ten thousand Hub Bucks. Hope you weren't thinking of stealing it. I'd have to kill you. I almost killed someone once, so you don't want to mess with me!

entries.text: Man, you're stupid. Oh, sorry, I didn't mean to offend you. Now let's try this again. "Yes" means I blow your head off. "No" means you get your butt out of here. Which is it going to be?
